calibration_sources: Kubernetes Kueue Topology-Aware Scheduling (TAS: Block / Rack / Node Hierarchy & Cohort Borrowing)
Kubernetes Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA v1beta1 ResourceClaim for Atomic GPU + RDMA NIC PCIe Alignment)
Sunk / CoreWeave Slurm-on-Kubernetes & Volcano Gang Scheduling Benchmarks

workload.cluster_scale: 1,024x H100/H200 GPUs (128 Nodes x 8 GPUs + 8 400G RDMA NICs) running mixed Distributed Training + Elastic Online Inference
workload.gang_deadlock_hazard: Without PodGroup all-or-nothing Gang Scheduling, Job A grabs 256/512 GPUs and Job B grabs 256/512 GPUs -> both deadlock forever
workload.dra_and_tas_mechanism: Kueue TAS packs jobs into compact Rail/Rack domains; K8s DRA atomically binds GPU i + mlx5_i on the same PCIe Switch

tiers.name: Tier 1: 原生 Kubernetes 默认调度器 + 传统 Device Plugin (逐 Pod 调度引发互锁死锁 18.5% + 跨机柜随机打散)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Vanilla K8s Default Scheduler + Legacy Device Plugin (18.5% Deadlock Waste · 36.4% MFU)
tiers.scheduler_and_resource_api: kube-scheduler per-Pod binding + integer nvidia.com/gpu Device Plugin (blind to PCIe/NIC/Rack topology)
tiers.training_and_inference_unification: Unified K8s pool, but concurrent multi-node jobs deadlock on partial GPU claims and scatter across Spine switches
tiers.recommended_for: Stateless 1-GPU microservices only; never run multi-node distributed training on vanilla kube-scheduler.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 物理隔离双集群：裸金属 Slurm 训练池 (512卡) + 独立 K8s 推理池 (512卡) (昼夜潮汐无法互借 -> 24.2% 算力搁浅)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Split Bare-Metal Slurm (512 GPUs) + Separate K8s Silo (512 GPUs) (73.8% Overall Util · $3.52M Waste)
tiers.scheduler_and_resource_api: Slurm topology/tree for training silo + Kubernetes for inference silo (zero dynamic cross-silo sharing)
tiers.training_and_inference_unification: Inference GPUs sit 60% idle at night while Slurm queue is full; Slurm maintenance requires manual OS re-imaging
tiers.recommended_for: Dedicated 100%-training labs with zero online inference services.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 统一 K8s + Kueue / Volcano 成组调度 (Gang) + 传统 Device Plugin (消灭死锁，但子卡分配仍跨 PCIe Root)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Unified K8s + Kueue/Volcano Gang Scheduling + Legacy Device Plugin (0% Deadlock · 86.5% Util · 51.2% MFU)
tiers.scheduler_and_resource_api: Kueue/Volcano PodGroup all-or-nothing admission + static node labels + legacy integer Device Plugin
tiers.training_and_inference_unification: Shares GPUs across day/night cohorts, but 2/4-GPU jobs suffer GPU-NIC PCIe cross-socket mismatches
tiers.recommended_for: Kubernetes clusters on K8s <1.30 before Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA) and Kueue TAS are enabled.

tiers.name: Tier 4: 统一 K8s + Kueue TAS 拓扑亲和 + K8s DRA (GPU+网卡原子绑定) + Sunk (Slurm-on-K8s 双栖融合) 🏆
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Unified K8s + Kueue TAS + K8s DRA (GPU+NIC Co-Alloc) + Sunk Slurm Bridge (94.6% Util · 57.8% MFU 🏆)
tiers.scheduler_and_resource_api: Kueue Topology-Aware Scheduling (Block/Rack/Rail) + K8s DRA ResourceClaim (GPU i + mlx5_i) + Sunk sbatch
tiers.training_and_inference_unification: 100% unified pool: researchers use sbatch/srun, SREs use K8s HPA, nighttime training borrows idle inference GPUs
tiers.recommended_for: Production 512-16,384+ GPU AI clouds and enterprise platforms running both training (Slurm/PyTorchJob) and inference.
